source_relationship.native_trace: Actual provider C emits a 48-byte plan from modeled allocation/OF inputs, with core0 DMA request base 0x83000000. The raw native firmware consumes exactly those bytes, admits that dynamic request base through DISCOVER/version/six bootstrap commands/BIND/STATUS and parks all eight harts. The old 0x82000000 fixture, an offset, CPU alias, binary base, zero and all-ones addresses are rejected before payload reads. No ELF bytes are injected after raw loading. SRAM/identity publication is explicitly modeled in this test, not performed by Linux.
